summary: Published seo-gap-miner as a bounded, read-only review skill that grounds every ranked gap in supplied demand and page evidence, with a green hosted harness, clean registry install, and production-signed dogfood receipt.

package.name: seo-gap-miner
package.publish_method: runx login --provider github --for publish; runx registry publish ./skills/seo-gap-miner/SKILL.md --registry https://api.runx.ai

observations: runx --version returned runx-cli 0.7.1, above the required 0.6.14 floor.
The registry publisher and public catalog owner are both gebibd00-jpg, and the exact package name is seo-gap-miner.
The hosted registry harness is green at 3/3 for grounded-content-gaps-sealed, thin-demand-needs-more-evidence, and missing-input-needs-agent.
The ready case returns two prioritized findings grounded in named demand signals and named weak pages, and drops the gambling term with the policy exclusion named.
The thin-demand case returns decision needs_more_evidence, zero findings, and the stop reason that no supplied term has both a named demand signal and source.
Every emitted finding names draft-content as a separate downstream dispatch target; the skill fetches no URL, runs no crawler, publishes nothing, and emits no proposal envelope.
A clean install succeeded with runx add gebibd00-jpg/seo-gap-miner@sha-2227534793ca --registry https://api.runx.ai.
The post-publish dogfood run returned decision ready and one high-priority gap grounded in the supplied Search Console fixture and the named weak governance page.
The dogfood receipt uses an Ed25519 hosted issuer and passes runx verify without --allow-local-development-signatures; the verdict is valid in production mode.
A new user can install the registry ref, run it with the three typed JSON inputs, then verify the saved receipt using the public verification key recorded in verification.json.
